notes:
Contact: Ethan Rivera (Head of Support Tech)
- Context: SysFlow runs a cloud-native contact center SaaS used by retail and fintech customers. They want to add AI-powered agent assist + automated tool-calls into Zendesk + internal refund API. Primary goal: reduce AHT (avg handle time) and error rate on refunds during high-volume spikes.
- POC scope: 2-week sandbox for agent-assist model + tool-calling to create/update tickets, trigger refunds (Stripe API proxy), and escalate to PagerDuty when confidence below threshold.
- Latency/throughput targets: 150-300ms generate for assistant suggestions; tool-call end-to-end (LLM -> action -> downstream API) targeted <700ms median, 99th <2s. Baseline throughput 5k reqs/min; must tolerate spikes to 50k reqs/min for promotions.
- Reliability needs: exact-once semantics for refund and ticket-create calls (idempotency tokens), robust retry/backoff and dead-lettering. Observability: per-action tracing, token-level cost breakdowns, and audit logs for compliance.
- Model preferences: lean on hosted open models with quantized variants for cost; fall back to simpler template-based response if model unavailable. Need routing by cost/latency region-aware.
- Security: SSO (Okta) + SAML, strict retention controls (30-90d depending on customer), SOC2 + ISO27001 requested, KMS for keys, EU data residency for several clients.
- Integration constraints: Zendesk via REST (rate limits), internal refund microservice behind private VPC with mTLS. They require a Private or Dedicated flavor for production; okay to start Hosted for POC.
- Quote from Ethan: "We can’t have phantom refunds — need a guarantee that once the agent clicks 'refund', it will either succeed exactly once or be safely retried with clear audit trail."
- Linked artifacts: demo video + call transcript in Drive, security questionnaire pending (doc linked), Fireflies call ff_20260212_8b3f2c contains exact requirements.
- Commercial: interested in reserved throughput for Black Friday-type spikes; CFO wants clear unit economics (cost per successful tool-call) before procurement.
- POC success criteria: 1) <5% failure rate on automated refunds, 2) 20% reduction in AHT for tier-1 refunds, 3) tracing/audit demonstrated to internal sec team.
- Internal stakeholders: Ethan Rivera (Head of Support Tech), Priya Malhotra (VP Ops), Daniel Cho (Platform Eng lead).
- Notes style: shorthand on calls, several follow-ups sent. Procurement timeline aggressive: wants contract signed before 2026-05 to prep for Q3 campaign.
